Software Engineer Associate - Technology Development Program 2027, Atlanta, GA
Atlanta, GA
Full-time
Hybrid
New Grad

Cargill is a global company providing food, agricultural, animal nutrition, and industrial solutions. The Software Engineer Associate will develop, test, maintain, troubleshoot, and document technology solutions while collaborating with global teams through a two-year rotational Technology Development Program.

No H1B
Responsibilities
Develop, test, integrate, maintain, troubleshoot and document software solutions
Ensure code quality and incorporate security practices in newly developed and maintained applications
Collaborate with the team to adopt agile philosophies, participate in agile ceremonies and help to identify improvements
Participate in peer code reviews and learn and adapt to the company's engineering and development practices
Participate in the engineering community by maintaining and sharing relevant technical approaches and modern skills
Partner collaboratively with other teams to deliver digital solutions
Handle basic issues and problems under direct supervision, while escalating more complex issues to appropriate staff
Other duties as assigned

Right to work in the U.S. that is not based solely on possession of a student visa or a visa sponsored by a third-party employer
Bachelor's degree with a major OR minor in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or other technology related discipline
Graduating with a degree between December 2025 and Summer 2026
Available to start June 2026
Minimum 3.0 GPA
All candidates must be willing and able to relocate to Atlanta, GA (if applicable)
Knowledge of basic structured programming, systems analysis and design, database design, and business concepts
Must possess a high degree of initiative and resourcefulness in completing work with limited guidance
Proven ability to work effectively with individuals from diverse a diverse set of backgrounds and cultures
Ability to relate technical knowledge to job-related duties
Preferred
Previously completed a software engineering internship
Commercial product software development experience
Experience with agile development methodologies
Demonstrated analytical and technical skills
Strong prioritization and problem-solving skills, collaboration skills, verbal and written communication skills, and information research and gathering skills
